scope: Step E official WBC gate logic
summary: Single file contains the official WBC gate. tau_wbc_norm > 0.001 is used as proxy for WBC 'applied', but this is a false positive since tau_wbc_norm is structural QP support feedforward output, not active WBC control authority.

files_with_wbc_gate_logic.current_logic: wbc_applied = any(tau_wbc_norm > 0.001 for row in rows)
files_with_wbc_gate_logic.issue: False positive - tau_wbc_norm includes QP structural support feedforward, not active WBC control
files_with_wbc_gate_logic.fix_needed: Replace with active WBC authority check using per_actuator_wbc_authority_enabled or ownership-based detection

files_with_tau_wbc_norm_diagnostic_only.note: These are telemetry logging only - should remain as-is but clearly labeled as structural QP output

tau_wbc_norm.description: L2 norm of WBC torques from BalanceCoreTorqueComposer

per_actuator_wbc_authority_enabled.description: Flag indicating per-actuator WBC authority is enabled (separate from QP structural output)

recommended_fix.description: Replace tau_wbc_norm > 0.001 check with per_actuator_wbc_authority_enabled check
recommended_fix.fallback_logic: Check active_torque_owner_per_joint for any WBC-related owners excluding support_feedforward

impact.tests_to_add: tests/test_step_e_validator.py or update existing validator tests
